hooks.name: Load Project Context on Session Start

action.prompt: At the start of every session, ALWAYS read PROJECT_CONTEXT.md first (quick reference), then PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md for deeper context. Do this before responding to the user's first message or taking any action. At the END of every session (when the Stop trigger fires), update both PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md to reflect all changes made during the session — new endpoints, new screens, schema changes, bug fixes, and any new known issues.
